newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - ROHISHKIS MOST ACTIVE CM STOCK LAST WEEK.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - ROHISHKIS MOST ACTIVE CM STOCK LAST WEEK.

text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange said on Monday that official list company Rokishkis Cheese had the bigest turnover on the central market last week in trade of 370,000 litas.
Rokishkis was followed by Hermis Bank with turnover of 331,000 litas and electronic producer Vilniaus Vingis in trade of 311,000 litas, the bourse said.
Hermis Bank topped the block trades last week in turnover of 3.148 million litas.
The bank was followed by Kedainiai Grudai which saw 1.346 million litas worth of its shares change hands and Baltijos Shipyard which registered business of 448,000 litas in block trades last week.
The bourse said that the group A gainer of the week was Malsena, which rose 19.81 percent.
Pharmaceutical producer Sanitas lost the most ground, easing by 15.45 percent, the bourse said.
Krekenavos Agrocompany and Akmenes Cementas were down 11.39 percent and ten percent respectively, the bourse added.
